name: Ambrose Supervisor
author: project-ambrose@example.invalid
description: Runs the Ambrose supervisor and its headless Wizard101 services.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 027
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake ninja-build git pkg-config curl zip unzip tar ca-certificates
export VCPKG_ROOT=/opt/vcpkg
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${AMBROSE_SOURCE_REF:-main}" https://github.com/Justchicoo/Project-Ambrose.git /tmp/ambrose
git clone https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg.git "$VCPKG_ROOT"
"$VCPKG_ROOT/bootstrap-vcpkg.sh" -disableMetrics
cd /tmp/ambrose
cmake --preset linux-gcc
cmake --build build/linux-gcc --config RelWithDebInfo --parallel --target supervisor loginserver gameserver patchserver
mkdir -p /mnt/server/bin /mnt/server/lib /mnt/server/config /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/backups
cp -a build/linux-gcc/bin/RelWithDebInfo/. /mnt/server/bin/
find build/linux-gcc/vcpkg_installed/x64-linux/lib -maxdepth 1 -name '*.so*' -exec cp -a {} /mnt/server/lib/ \;
cp /mnt/server/bin/supervisor.conf.dist /mnt/server/config/supervisor.conf
for app in loginserver gameserver patchserver; do cp "/mnt/server/bin/$app.conf.dist" "/mnt/server/config/$app.conf"; done
sed -i 's#^LogsDir = .*#LogsDir = /home/container/logs#; s#^Panel.Enable =.*#Panel.Enable = 1#' /mnt/server/config/supervisor.conf
client_dir=${AMBROSE_CLIENT_DIR:-/home/container/client}
case "$client_dir" in *'#'*|*'&'*|*'\\'*) echo 'AMBROSE_CLIENT_DIR cannot contain #, &, or backslash' >&2; exit 1;; esac
sed -i "s#^ClientDir =.*#ClientDir = $client_dir#" /mnt/server/config/loginserver.conf /mnt/server/config/gameserver.conf
sed -i 's#^App.loginserver.Config =.*#App.loginserver.Config = /home/container/config/loginserver.conf#; s#^App.gameserver.Config =.*#App.gameserver.Config = /home/container/config/gameserver.conf#; s#^App.patchserver.Config =.*#App.patchserver.Config = /home/container/config/patchserver.conf#; s#^App.loginserver.WorkingDirectory =.*#App.loginserver.WorkingDirectory = /home/container#; s#^App.gameserver.WorkingDirectory =.*#App.gameserver.WorkingDirectory = /home/container#; s#^App.patchserver.WorkingDirectory =.*#App.patchserver.WorkingDirectory = /home/container#' /mnt/server/config/supervisor.conf
chmod 0640 /mnt/server/config/supervisor.conf /mnt/server/config/loginserver.conf /mnt/server/config/gameserver.conf /mnt/server/config/patchserver.conf
